Air Force Chief Flies Final Sortie in Tejas Jet

Air Chief Marshal AP Singh undertook his final fighter jet sortie in an indigenous Tejas aircraft prior to his retirement. The flight took place as part of the Tarang Shakti 2026 exercise.
